pitch2.headline: The freelance market is splitting
pitch2.body:
Writing jobs are down 33%. Translation down 19%. AI-related freelance work is up 60%.

**Two kinds of freelancers are emerging.** Generalists treating AI as a shortcut are becoming commodities. Specialists who trained deliberately are charging premiums — and winning more of the work that's left.

49% of hiring managers expect to increase freelancer hiring over the next two years. The question is which freelancers.

pitch.headline: Why most freelancers plateau with AI
pitch.body:
Knowing a tool exists is not the same as knowing how to use it for your work.

**Four competencies separate high-earning AI users from casual ones:** prompt engineering for client deliverables, critical evaluation of AI output, workflow integration, and domain calibration.

AITutoro assesses your actual level first, then builds those four competencies in your specific work context.
